core: FTTH expansion is steadily replacing legacy access.
meaning_cn: FTTH 扩张正在稳步替代传统接入方式。
explanation_cn: steadily 表示持续、稳定地推进，适合描述渐进式网络迁移。legacy access 指 HFC、铜线等传统接入方式，比 old networks 更正式。若只表达技术替代而不强调建设规模，也可写 FTTH is steadily replacing legacy access。
source_sentence: FTTH expansion is steadily replacing legacy access

examples.en: Fiber expansion is steadily replacing legacy copper access.
examples.cn: 光纤扩张正在稳步替代传统铜线接入。

examples.en: FTTH is gradually replacing HFC in high-value areas.
examples.cn: FTTH 正在高价值区域逐步替代 HFC。

examples.en: The migration to fiber is accelerating as legacy networks are retired.
examples.cn: 随着传统网络退网，向光纤迁移正在加速。

pronunciation.text: FTTH expansion is steadily replacing legacy access.
pronunciation.hint_cn: FTTH、steadily replacing 和 legacy access 承担主要信息重音；legacy 的首音节重读。

core: The fiber subscriber base is expanding rapidly.
meaning_cn: 光纤用户规模正在快速扩大。
explanation_cn: subscriber base 指一个运营商或业务的用户总体规模，比 fiber users are growing 更适合商业分析。expand rapidly 强调规模快速扩大；若强调新增用户数量，可写 Fiber net additions are accelerating。

examples.en: The FTTH subscriber base is expanding rapidly across major cities.
examples.cn: FTTH 用户规模正在主要城市快速扩大。

examples.en: Fiber net additions are accelerating as migration gains momentum.
examples.cn: 随着迁移提速，光纤净增用户正在加速。

examples.en: The operator is seeing rapid growth in its fiber subscriber base.
examples.cn: 该运营商的光纤用户规模正在快速增长。

pronunciation.text: The fiber subscriber base is expanding rapidly.
pronunciation.hint_cn: fiber subscriber base、expanding 和 rapidly 承担主要信息重音；subscriber 重音在第二音节。

core: Average broadband speed reached 130 Mbps in 2026, up 60% in one year.
meaning_cn: 2026 年平均宽带速率达到 130 Mbps，一年内增长了 60%。
explanation_cn: 描述指标达到某个水平时用 reached。up 60% in one year 是图表和 PPT 中常见的紧凑表达，表示相比一年前增长 60%；不能用 add 60%。若数据是同比口径，也可写 up 60% year on year。
source_sentence: 130 Mbps in 2026, add 60% in one year

examples.en: Average download speed reached 150 Mbps, up 25% year on year.
examples.cn: 平均下载速率达到 150 Mbps，同比增长 25%。

examples.en: The metric rose to 130 Mbps in 2026, an increase of 60% in one year.
examples.cn: 该指标在 2026 年升至 130 Mbps，一年增长 60%。

examples.en: Broadband speeds increased by 60% over the past year.
examples.cn: 过去一年宽带速率增长了 60%。

pronunciation.text: Average broadband speed reached 130 Mbps in 2026, up 60% in one year.
pronunciation.hint_cn: average broadband speed、130 Mbps、up 60% 和 one year 承担主要信息重音。

core: Claro trails competitors in customer experience.
meaning_cn: Claro 在客户体验方面落后于竞争对手。
explanation_cn: trail competitors in... 是商业分析和 PPT 标题中表达“在某方面落后于竞对”的简洁结构。原句中的 a experience 应改为 an experience，但 has an experience gap 仍不够自然。若数据只证明存在差距、不能判断领先或落后，可改为 Claro has a customer experience gap versus competitors。
source_sentence: Claro Has a Experience Gap vs Competitors

examples.en: Claro trails its main competitors in average download speed.
examples.cn: Claro 在平均下载速率方面落后于主要竞争对手。

examples.en: The brand still trails competitors in perceived service quality.
examples.cn: 该品牌在用户感知的服务质量方面仍落后于竞争对手。

examples.en: Claro has narrowed the customer experience gap, but it has not achieved clear leadership.
examples.cn: Claro 已缩小客户体验差距，但尚未形成明确领先。

pronunciation.text: Claro trails competitors in customer experience.
pronunciation.hint_cn: trails、competitors 和 customer experience 承担主要信息重音；competitors 重音在第二音节。

core: Claro continues to grow, but slower subscriber expansion and limited speed leadership constrain value growth.
meaning_cn: Claro 仍在增长，但用户扩张放缓和速率领先不足限制了价值增长。
explanation_cn: continues to grow, but... 适合先肯定增长，再指出结构性约束。补充 subscriber 使 expansion 的对象更明确。constrain 比 stop 更客观，表示限制而非完全阻止。value growth 适合概括高价值用户、ARPU 或高端套餐增长，但正式材料中应结合具体指标解释。
source_sentence: Claro continues to grow, but slower expansion and limited speed leadership constrain value growth

examples.en: The business continues to grow, but weaker net additions constrain revenue expansion.
examples.cn: 业务仍在增长，但净新增减弱限制了收入扩张。

examples.en: Subscriber growth remains positive, but limited premium-plan adoption constrains value growth.
examples.cn: 用户增长仍为正，但高端套餐采用不足限制了价值增长。

examples.en: Claro is expanding, but it lacks a clear speed advantage over competitors.
examples.cn: Claro 正在扩张，但相较竞争对手缺乏明确的速率优势。

pronunciation.text: Claro continues to grow, but slower subscriber expansion and limited speed leadership constrain value growth.
pronunciation.hint_cn: continues to grow、slower subscriber expansion、limited speed leadership 和 constrain value growth 是四个主要意群。

core: FTTH subscribers are growing rapidly, with a CAGR of 41%.
meaning_cn: FTTH 用户正在快速增长，复合年增长率为 41%。
explanation_cn: with a CAGR of 41% 是在一句话中补充增长强度的常用结构。CAGR 是 compound annual growth rate，前面通常用 a CAGR of，而不是 CAGR 41%。正式图表必须同时标明计算起止年份，否则 41% 的时间口径不完整。

examples.en: FTTH subscribers grew at a CAGR of 41% from 2023 to 2026.
examples.cn: 2023 至 2026 年，FTTH 用户复合年增长率为 41%。

examples.en: Fiber adoption is accelerating, with a three-year CAGR of 35%.
examples.cn: 光纤采用正在加速，三年复合年增长率为 35%。

examples.en: The subscriber base reached 500,000 after growing at a CAGR of 20%.
examples.cn: 用户规模以 20% 的复合年增长率增长后达到 50 万。

pronunciation.text: FTTH subscribers are growing rapidly, with a CAGR of 41%.
pronunciation.hint_cn: FTTH subscribers、growing rapidly 和 CAGR of 41% 承担主要信息重音；CAGR 通常逐字母读出。
